3_the actor, julián, is played by the great ricardo darín, an argentine star with a quick wit and a wry, buoyant presence.
4_there are things in life and art that are simply so beautiful that they must be witnessed, and darín's performance in "truman" is one of those.

2_"truman," a great success in its native spain, is definitely done right.
3_canine power is far from the only thing the film has got going for it.
5_"truman" avoids preachiness as scrupulously as it evades certainty.
7_the film is restrained and observational, its impact cumulative.
9_the film's real triumph is in how accurately it captures the intricacies of human relationships, especially when tested.

10_cesc gay's wise, wistful and well-observed film about two friends enjoying a final reunion in the shadow of impending death, is by turns amusing and affecting - and quite often both at once.
